All admin screens

The site

  • LifecycleWhat state guests see, what the calendar suggests, and previewing another state.
  • Feature flagsBoth halves of every gate, and the two legal switches that stay shut.
  • ContentRecords with provenance, freshness and verification.
  • Events & RSVP windowEvents, meal options, notices, and when RSVP opens.

Guests

  • GuestsPeople, households they belong to, identity resets.
  • HouseholdsHousehold records and mailing addresses.
  • InvitationsIssue, rotate and revoke invitation links.
  • RSVPsWho has replied, overrides and exports.
  • SeatingTables, assignments and publishing the chart.

The weekend

  • Travel & stayHotels, links and the room block.
  • TransportBenefit entitlements and voucher codes.
  • GiftsRegistry and gift links.
  • ReservationsVenues guests can book through.

Media & AI

  • MediaModeration queue, imports and duplicates.
  • Media AICaptions, indexing and what the model may touch.
  • ConciergeAnswer traces, grounding failures, security alerts.

Operations

  • Audit trailEvery action anyone took, searchable, redacted.
  • JobsQueue depth, failures and retries.
  • MetricsWhat this deployment recorded, and whether it is recording.
  • ProvidersWhich adapter each integration resolved to, and what it can do.
